description.en: After the Mukden Incident Japanese forces advanced west from Shenyang and took Jinzhou on 3 January 1932. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

description.zh: 1933 年 1 月 1 日日军自锦州方向进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，3 日榆关失守。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 1 January 1933 Japanese forces from the Jinzhou direction attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted until the pass fell on 3 January. Illustrative simplified route.

name.zh: 锦州—朝阳—承德（热河作战）

description.zh: 1933 年 2 月 21 日日军分路进攻热河，3 月 4 日占领承德。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: On 21 February 1933 Japanese forces attacked Rehe along several axes and occupied Chengde on 4 March. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

description.zh: 热河失守后日军南下进攻古北口，与中国守军在长城一线激战。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Rehe Japanese forces moved south against Gubeikou and fought Chinese defenders along the Great Wall. Illustrative simplified route.

name.zh: 山海关—喜峰口（长城东段）

description.zh: 日军沿长城东段进攻喜峰口、冷口等关口，第二十九军等部在此抵抗。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Xifengkou, Lengkou, and other passes along the eastern Great Wall, where the 29th Army and others resisted. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 商都—红格尔图—百灵庙（绥远作战）

description.zh: 日本关东军策动伪蒙军自商都西进，进攻红格尔图与百灵庙，被傅作义部击退。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: The Kwantung Army directed Mengjiang forces west from Shangdu against Honggeertu and Bailingmiao, where Fu Zuoyi’s troops repelled them. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 天尾港—海口（日军登陆海南岛）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，分左右两翼攻占府城、海口；守军保安部队抵抗后撤往定安山区。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: On 10 February 1939 the Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Fucheng and Haikou in two wings; the security troops withdrew to the Ding’an mountains after resisting. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 三亚湾—榆林（日军登陆三亚）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日拂晓，日本海军陆战队在三亚湾登陆，当日占领三亚、榆林，深夜占领崖城。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: At dawn on 14 February 1939 Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Sanya Bay, took Sanya and Yulin that day and Yacheng late that night. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

description.zh: 日军占领石碌后修建石碌—八所港铁路和八所港码头，将铁矿砂运往日本；示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: After occupying Shilu, Japan built the Shilu–Basuo railway and Basuo port to ship iron ore to Japan; schematic simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 长春—吉林（九一八后东进）

description.zh: 1931 年 9 月 19 日至 21 日，日军自长春沿吉长铁路东进，占领吉林省城吉林。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 19 to 21 September 1931 Japanese forces advanced east from Changchun along the Jilin–Changchun railway and occupied Jilin City. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 长春—洮南—齐齐哈尔（江桥作战）

description.zh: 1931 年 11 月，日军第 2 师团等部沿洮昂铁路北犯，在嫩江江桥遭马占山部抵抗，11 月 19 日占领齐齐哈尔。示意简化路线。
description.en: In November 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other units advanced north along the Tao’ang railway, met Ma Zhanshan’s resistance at the Nen River bridge, and occupied Qiqihar on 19 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金山卫—嘉兴—杭州（第10军登陆）

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，经嘉兴西进，12 月 24 日占领杭州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei, advanced west through Jiaxing and occupied Hangzhou on 24 December. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1937 年 12 月 27 日济南沦陷后，日军沿胶济铁路东进，1938 年 1 月 10 日占领青岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jinan on 27 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced east along the Jiaoji railway and occupied Qingdao on 10 January 1938. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月 10 日，日军在厦门五通登陆，经莲坂、市区推进，5 月 13 日控制厦门全岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 10 May 1938 Japanese forces landed at Wutong on Xiamen Island, advanced through Lianban and the city, and controlled the whole island by 13 May. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—虎门—深圳（切断粤港交通）

description.zh: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军第 18 师团自虎门出发，在宝安登陆，8 月 15 日占领南头、深圳，切断粤港陆路交通。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 13 August 1939 the Japanese 18th Division moved from Humen, landed in Bao’an, and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen on 15 August, cutting the Guangdong–Hong Kong land route. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 21 日凌晨，日军在汕头港外妈屿岛登陆，22 日凌晨攻入汕头市区。示意简化路线。
description.en: Before dawn on 21 June 1939 Japanese forces landed on Mayu Island outside Shantou harbour and entered central Shantou in the early hours of 22 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 25 日，日军自汕头北上进攻潮州，27 日占领潮州城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 25 June 1939 Japanese forces advanced north from Shantou toward Chaozhou and occupied the city on 27 June. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 南宁—镇南关—河内（进驻法属印度支那北部）

description.zh: 1940 年 9 月 22 日，日军自镇南关进入法属印度支那北部，经谅山进驻河内，切断滇越铁路。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 22 September 1940 Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina through Zhennanguan, advanced via Lang Son and occupied Hanoi, cutting the Yunnan–Vietnam railway. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 16 日至 17 日，日军第 13 军自杭州附近南渡钱塘江，占领绍兴，宁绍战役开始。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 16 to 17 April 1941 the Japanese 13th Army crossed the Qiantang River south of Hangzhou and occupied Shaoxing, opening the Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 镇海—宁波（宁绍战役登陆）

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 19 日，日军在镇海登陆，沿甬江西进，4 月 20 日占领宁波。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 19 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at Zhenhai and advanced west along the Yong River, occupying Ningbo on 20 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 瑞安—温州（温州第一次沦陷）

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 18 日，日军在瑞安飞云江口登陆，占领瑞安，19 日北犯温州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth, occupied Rui’an and advanced north to Wenzhou on 19 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 闽江口—福州（第一次福州战役）
name.en: Min River estuary–Fuzhou (first battle for Fuzhou)

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 19 日，日军在闽江口两侧登陆，经连江、长乐向福州推进，21 日占领福州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 19 April 1941 Japanese forces landed on both sides of the Min River estuary, advanced on Fuzhou via Lianjiang and Changle, and occupied the city on 21 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 畹町—龙陵—惠通桥（日军侵入滇西）
name.en: Wanding–Longling–Huitong Bridge (Japanese invasion of western Yunnan)

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 3 日，日军自缅甸占领畹町，沿滇缅公路北犯，4 日占龙陵，5 日进抵惠通桥，被阻于怒江。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 3 May 1942 Japanese forces occupied Wanding from Burma, advanced north along the Burma Road, took Longling on 4 May and reached the Huitong Bridge on 5 May, where they were halted at the Salween. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 闽江口—福州（第二次福州战役）
name.en: Min River estuary–Fuzhou (second battle for Fuzhou)

description.zh: 1944 年 9 月 27 日，日军在闽江口登陆，经连江、马尾向福州推进，10 月 4 日占领福州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 27 September 1944 Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary, advanced on Fuzhou via Lianjiang and Mawei, and occupied the city on 4 October. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 柳州—河池—独山（黔南事变）

description.zh: 1944 年 11 月 11 日柳州沦陷后，日军沿黔桂铁路北犯，经河池、南丹，12 月 2 日攻占贵州独山。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Liuzhou on 11 November 1944, Japanese forces advanced north along the Guizhou–Guangxi railway through Hechi and Nandan and captured Dushan, Guizhou, on 2 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 通明—海康—遂溪—广州湾（雷州半岛作战）

description.zh: 1943 年 2 月 16 日，日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸通明、下岚登陆，占领海康、遂溪，21 日占领广州湾西营。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 16 February 1943 the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed at Tongming and Xialan on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula, occupied Haikang and Suixi, and took Xiyang in Guangzhouwan on 21 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 韶关—南雄—大余—赣州（湘粤赣边区作战）

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月 28 日韶关沦陷后，日军沿粤汉铁路和赣粤公路北犯，经始兴、南雄、大余，2 月 5 日进占赣州。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Shaoguan on 28 January 1945, Japanese forces advanced north along the Canton–Hankou railway and the Jiangxi–Guangdong road through Shixing, Nanxiong and Dayu, entering Ganzhou on 5 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 遂川—赣州（遂川机场作战）

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月 31 日，日军第 27 师团攻占遂川机场，随后沿公路南下，2 月 5 日进占赣州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 31 January 1945 the Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south along the road, entering Ganzhou on 5 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金华—丽水—青田—温州（温州第二次沦陷）

description.zh: 1942 年 7 月，日军小薗江混成旅团自金华沿丽水、青田南犯，7 月 11 日占领温州。示意简化路线。
description.en: In July 1942 the Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian, occupying Wenzhou on 11 July. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金华—丽水—青田—温州（温州第三次沦陷）

description.zh: 1944 年 8 月至 9 月，日军第 13 军甲支队自金华经丽水、青田南犯，9 月 9 日占领温州并长期盘踞。示意简化路线。
description.en: From August to September 1944 the Japanese 13th Army’s Kō Detachment advanced south from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian, occupying Wenzhou on 9 September and remaining for a prolonged period. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 南口—张家口—大同（平绥线）

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，8 月 27 日占张家口，9 月 13 日占大同。示意简化路线。
description.en: In August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway, taking Zhangjiakou on 27 August and Datong on 13 September. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 北平—保定—石家庄（平汉线）

description.zh: 1937 年 7 月北平沦陷后，日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，9 月 24 日占保定，10 月 10 日占石家庄。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Beiping in July 1937, the Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway, taking Baoding on 24 September and Shijiazhuang on 10 October. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 石家庄—娘子关—太原（正太线）

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，日军沿正太线西进，10 月 26 日占娘子关，11 月 8 日占太原。示意简化路线。
description.en: In October 1937 Japanese forces advanced west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, taking Niangziguan on 26 October and Taiyuan on 8 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 大同—归绥—包头（平绥线西段）

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月大同沦陷后，日军沿平绥线西进，经丰镇、集宁、卓资，10 月 14 日占归绥，16 日占萨拉齐，17 日占包头。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Datong in September 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Beiping–Suiyuan railway through Fengzhen, Jining and Zhuozi, taking Guisui on 14 October, Salaqi on the 16th and Baotou on the 17th. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月田独铁矿开采后，矿石经约 10 公里轻便铁路运至榆林港矿石码头装船。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the Tiandu mine opened in July 1939, ore was carried by a roughly 10-km light railway to the ore terminal at Yulin port for shipment. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 榆林—北黎（榆林—北黎铁路）

description.zh: 日军修建榆林—北黎铁路，全长约 187.9 公里，1943 年 3 月基本完工并在北黎与石八线接轨，连接榆林、三亚、八所等港口。示意简化路线。
description.en: Japan built the roughly 187.9-km Yulin–Beili railway, basically completed in March 1943 and joined to the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili, linking Yulin, Sanya, Basuo and other ports. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 老城—金江（澄迈湾登陆后西进）
name.en: Laocheng–Jinjiang (advance after the Chengmai Bay landing)

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日至 12 日，日军另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，随后向内地推进，4 月 14 日占澄迈县城金江。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 10 to 12 February 1939 another Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng and advanced inland, occupying Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county, on 14 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 白马井—新英—新州（儋县登陆）

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，日军川崎部队与海军陆战队在白马井登陆，4 月 17 日占新英港，4 月 18 日占儋县县城新州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 16 April 1939 the Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing, took Xinying port on 17 April and Xinzhou, seat of Dan county, on 18 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 头灶港—崖城（崖州湾登陆）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日，日军从头灶港、大旦港、马岭干溪登陆，三路进攻崖城，2 月 15 日占领崖县县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 14 February 1939 Japanese forces landed at Touzao, Dadan and the dry creek west of Maling and attacked Yacheng by three routes, occupying the county seat on 15 February. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日海口、府城失守后，日军自海口东进，2 月 20 日攻占定安县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Haikou and Fucheng on 10 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced east from Haikou and captured Ding’an county town on 20 February. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日海口失守后，日军自海口东进，2 月 22 日占文昌县城文城，2 月 23 日进入清澜港。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Haikou on 10 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced east, occupied Wencheng on 22 February and entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 三亚—藤桥—陵水（东南沿海推进）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日日军登陆三亚后，沿海南东南沿海经藤桥向陵水推进，4 月 28 日占陵水县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After landing at Sanya on 14 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced along the southeast coast through Tengqiao toward Lingshui and occupied the county town on 28 April. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 22 日文昌失守后，日军自文昌、定安方向向琼东推进，4 月 15 日占嘉积。具体出发地待页码级核对；示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Wenchang on 22 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced from the Wenchang–Ding’an direction into Qiongdong and occupied Jiaji on 15 April. The exact departure point awaits page-level verification; schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 14 日澄迈金江失守后，日军自澄迈方向进攻临高，4 月 18 日占临高县城。另有 9 月 25 日新盈港登陆说，出发地待页码级核对；示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jinjiang on 14 April 1939, Japanese forces advanced from the Chengmai direction against Lingao and occupied the county town on 18 April. Another account has a landing at Xinying on 25 September; the departure point awaits page-level verification; schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 嘉积—万宁（琼东沿海推进）

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 15 日嘉积失守后，日军沿海南东海岸南下，8 月 13 日占万宁县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jiaji on 15 April 1939, Japanese forces advanced south along the east coast and occupied Wanning county town on 13 August. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻陵水日军出占保亭县城。示意简化路线；另有 1940-07-16 说。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Lingshui occupied Baoting county town. Schematic simplified route; another account gives 16 July 1940.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻崖县日军出占乐东县城（抱由）。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Ya county occupied Ledong county town (Baoyou). Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 八所—石碌（进攻石碌铁矿）
name.en: Basuo–Shilu (advance on the Shilu iron mine)

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日日军占八所、北黎，以此为基地向内地推进，1940 年 3 月 15 日占石碌。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces occupied Basuo and Beili and used them as bases for advancing inland, occupying Shilu on 15 March 1940. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 八所—墩头—新街（昌江沿海占领）

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军自八所、墩头登陆/推进，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设司令部。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces landed or advanced from Basuo and Duntou and occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, establishing headquarters at Beili. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日第 104 师团在平海登陆，13 日占稔山、吉隆，随后配合进攻惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the 104th Division landed at Pinghai, took Renshan and Jilong on 13 October and then supported the attack on Huizhou. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 盐灶背—平山—惠州（及川支队）

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日及川支队在盐灶背登陆，经平山方向配合进攻惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the Oikawa Detachment landed at Yanzaobei and advanced via Pingshan in support of the attack on Huizhou. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日第 18 师团在澳头、霞涌登陆，13 日占淡水，15 日占惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the 18th Division landed at Aotou and Xiachong, took Danshui on 13 October and Huizhou on 15 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 15 日惠州失守后，日军经博罗、增城向广州推进，21 日占广州。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Huizhou fell on 15 October 1938, Japanese forces advanced through Boluo and Zengcheng toward Guangzhou, occupying the city on 21 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 21 日广州失守后，第 104 师团向北推进，23 日占从化。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell on 21 October 1938, the 104th Division advanced north and occupied Conghua on 23 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 23 日，日军第 5 师团与海军攻占虎门要塞，控制珠江口。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts and controlled the Pearl River estuary. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 23 日虎门失守后，日军第 5 师团与海军沿珠江口西进，25 日占三水，26 日占佛山。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Humen fell on 23 October 1938, the Japanese 5th Division and navy advanced west along the Pearl River estuary, taking Sanshui on 25 October and Foshan on 26 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向珠江三角洲南部推进，26 日前后占顺德各属。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced into the southern Pearl River Delta and occupied Shunde’s towns around 26 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 3 月 28 日日军自广州方向进攻新会，30 日占江门，4 月 2 日占会城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 28 March 1939 Japanese forces advanced from the Guangzhou direction against Xinhui, took Jiangmen on 30 March and Huicheng on 2 April. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 5 日日军藤井兵团从顺德攻入中山大小黄圃，7 日占石岐。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 5 March 1940 the Japanese Fujii Brigade entered Dahuangpu and Xiaohuangpu in Zhongshan from Shunde and occupied Shiqi on 7 March. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 6 日日军海路登陆唐家、香洲，攻陷前山、坦洲、翠亨，配合主力包围石岐。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 6 March 1940 Japanese forces landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou, took Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng, and cooperated in the encirclement of Shiqi. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 27 日潮州失守后，日军沿韩江于 29 日进占澄海。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Chaozhou fell on 27 June 1939, Japanese forces advanced along the Han River and occupied Chenghai on 29 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 6 月 21 日日军在钱澳、长尾山登陆，23 日控制南澳全岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 21 June 1938 Japanese forces landed at Qian’ao and Changweishan and controlled all of Nan’ao by 23 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向广九铁路沿线推进，11 月 26 日第一次占领宝安南头、深圳镇。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced along the Guangzhou–Kowloon railway and first occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town on 26 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—花县—银盏坳—源潭—英德（第104师团）

description.zh: 1939 年 11 月 27 日起，日军第 104 师团由花县新街沿粤汉铁路北犯，经银盏坳、源潭，12 月 30 日占英德。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 27 November 1939 the Japanese 104th Division advanced north from Xinjie in Hua county along the Canton–Hankou railway through Yinzhan’ao and Yuantan, occupying Yingde on 30 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 增城—小楼—正果—永汉—左潭—梅坑—新丰（第18师团）

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 15 日，日军第 18 师团由增城北上，经小楼、正果、永汉、左潭、梅坑，28 日占新丰。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 15 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division advanced north from Zengcheng through Xiaolou, Zhengguo, Yonghan, Zuotan and Meikeng, occupying Xinfeng on 28 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 从化—鸡笼冈—良口—吕田—翁源—新江（近卫混成旅团）

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 20 日，日军近卫混成旅团占从化，经鸡笼冈、良口、吕田，30 日占翁源，31 日占新江。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 20 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Conghua and advanced through Jilonggang, Liangkou and Lü tian, taking Wengyuan on 30 December and Xinjiang on 31 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—街口—鸡笼冈—良口（第二次粤北）

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 13 日，日军第 38 师团沿广从公路北犯，17 日占街口，18 日占鸡笼冈，20 日占良口。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 13 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division advanced north along the Guangzhou–Conghua road, taking Jiekou on 17 May, Jilonggang on 18 May and Liangkou on 20 May. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 良口—石榴花顶（第二次粤北）

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 20 日良口失守后，日军于 22 日进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Liangkou fell on 20 May 1940, Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading on 22 May and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 新丰—梅坑—永汉—增城（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军第 18 师团由新丰、梅坑、永汉向南退却，逐步退回增城。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese 18th Division withdrew south from Xinfeng, Meikeng and Yonghan toward Zengcheng. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 新江—翁源—良口—从化—广州（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军近卫混成旅团由新江、翁源经良口、从化向南退却，退回广州。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade withdrew south from Xinjiang and Wengyuan via Liangkou and Conghua toward Guangzhou. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 英德—银盏坳—花县—广州（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军第 104 师团由英德沿粤汉铁路南退，经银盏坳、花县退回广州。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese 104th Division withdrew south from Yingde along the Canton–Hankou railway through Yinzhan’ao and Hua county toward Guangzhou. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 良口—街口—广州（1940-06 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 6 月 1 日，日军第 38 师团由良口、街口向南退却，退回广州；中国军队 6 月 3 日收复良口、5 日收复街口。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 June 1940 the Japanese 38th Division withdrew south from Liangkou and Jiekou toward Guangzhou; Chinese forces recovered Liangkou on 3 June and Jiekou on 5 June. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

description.zh: 1940 年 6 月 1 日，日军第 104 师团一部由花县向南退却，退回广州；中国军队 6 月 1 日收复花县。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 June 1940 elements of the Japanese 104th Division withdrew south from Hua county toward Guangzhou; Chinese forces recovered Hua county on 1 June. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

description.zh: 1937年11月13日，日军从白茆口、浒浦一带登陆，经支塘向常熟县城进犯，11月19日陷常熟。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 13 November 1937 Japanese forces landed at Baimaokou and Hupu, advanced via Zhitang on Changshu and took the town on 19 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月15日日军进攻昆山，随后沿京沪铁路西进，11月19日攻入苏州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Kunshan on 15 November 1937 and advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway, entering Suzhou on 19 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军由常熟向苏州进攻，与昆山方向一路合攻苏州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces advanced from Changshu toward Suzhou, converging with the Kunshan column. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日苏州失守后，日军沿京杭运河与铁路西进，11月25日侵占无锡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Suzhou fell on 19 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Grand Canal and railway and occupied Wuxi on 25 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月25日无锡失守后，日军第16师团沿铁路西进，11月29日攻占常州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuxi fell on 25 November 1937, the Japanese 16th Division advanced west along the railway and took Changzhou on 29 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月29日常州失守后，日军沿京沪铁路西进，12月2日陷丹阳，12月8日陷镇江。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Changzhou fell on 29 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway, taking Danyang on 2 December and Zhenjiang on 8 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月28日宜兴失守后，太湖南岸一路日军经溧阳、溧水、句容向南京迂回。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yixing fell on 28 November 1937, the Japanese column south of Taihu moved via Liyang, Lishui and Jurong to outflank Nanjing. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月29日常州失守后，日军第9师团经金坛西进，12月2日陷金坛，12月4日陷溧水。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Changzhou fell on 29 November 1937, the Japanese 9th Division advanced west via Jintan, taking Jintan on 2 December and Lishui on 4 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月25日无锡失守后，日军从无锡三面围攻江阴，12月2日攻占江阴要塞。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuxi fell on 25 November 1937, Japanese forces attacked Jiangyin from three directions and took the fortress on 2 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月8日镇江失守后，日军第13师团天谷支队渡江，12月14日攻占扬州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zhenjiang fell on 8 December 1937, the Japanese 13th Division's Amaya detachment crossed the Yangtze and took Yangzhou on 14 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在姚港登陆后直入南通城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed at Yaogang and entered Nantong. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月17日南通失守后，日军沿公路西进，3月19日侵占如皋。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Nantong fell on 17 March 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the road and occupied Rugao on 19 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月21日，日军由南通沿公路进犯海门，占领茅镇、三厂、青龙港、四甲坝。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 21 March 1938 Japanese forces advanced from Nantong along the road into Haimen, occupying Maozhen, Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月19日如皋失守后，日军连下海安、东台，3月25日侵占东台城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Rugao fell on 19 March 1938, Japanese forces took Hai'an and Dongtai in succession, occupying Dongtai on 25 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月25日东台失守后，日军北犯，4月26日占盐城，5月7日占阜宁。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Dongtai fell on 25 March 1938, Japanese forces advanced north, taking Yancheng on 26 April and Funing on 7 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年2月28日日军占领连云港，3月4日占领墟沟、新浦、海州，连云地区全境沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces occupied Lianyungang on 28 February 1939 and Xugou, Xinpu and Haizhou on 4 March, completing the occupation of the area. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月，日军由徐州沿宿睢公路东犯，11月22日攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In November 1938 Japanese forces advanced east from Xuzhou along the Suqian–Suining road and captured Suqian on 22 November in the common account. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军占宿迁后沿运河向淮阴推进，1939年3月1日侵入淮阴城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After occupying Suqian, Japanese forces advanced along the Grand Canal toward Huaiyin and entered the city on 1 March 1939. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年10月2日，日军由扬州沿运河北犯，侵占高邮城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces advanced north from Yangzhou along the Grand Canal and occupied Gaoyou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团由扬州方向进驻泰州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 February 1941 the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered Taizhou from the direction of Yangzhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月30日广德失守后，日军第18师团经郎溪北犯，12月6日陷宣城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Guangde fell on 30 November 1937, the Japanese 18th Division advanced north via Langxi and took Xuancheng on 6 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月6日宣城失守后，日军经湾沚西进，12月10日攻占芜湖。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xuancheng fell on 6 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced west via Wanzhi and took Wuhu on 10 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月10日芜湖失守后，日军沿长江东岸北进，12月11日陷当涂。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuhu fell on 10 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced north along the east bank of the Yangtze and took Dangtu on 11 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月11日当涂失守后，日军北进，12月23日占领马鞍山矿区。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Dangtu fell on 11 December 1937, Japanese forces moved north and occupied the Ma'anshan mines on 23 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月22日全椒失守后，日军沿滁河北进，12月24日陷滁县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Quanjiao fell on 22 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced north along the Chu River and took Chuxian on 24 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月18日明光失陷后，日军沿津浦铁路南段北犯，2月1日陷临淮关，2月2日陷蚌埠。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Mingguang fell on 18 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced north along the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway, taking Linhuaiguan on 1 February and Bengbu on 2 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月30日池河失陷后，日军西进，2月2日陷定远。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Chihe fell on 30 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced west and took Dingyuan on 2 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月2日蚌埠、凤阳同日失陷，日军由蚌埠向凤阳方向推进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Bengbu and Fengyang fell on the same day, 2 February 1938; Japanese forces moved from Bengbu toward Fengyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月5日，日军由蚌埠强渡淮河，进占怀远。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces crossed the Huai River from Bengbu and occupied Huaiyuan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月，日军第13师团由蚌埠西犯，5月9日陷蒙城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division advanced west from Bengbu and took Mengcheng on 9 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月18日至19日，日军由宿县北犯，萧县、宿县先后失陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 18–19 May 1938 Japanese forces moved north from Suxian; Xiaoxian and Suxian fell in succession. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月19日萧县失陷后，日军继续向砀山推进，5月24日陷砀山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xiaoxian fell on 19 May 1938, Japanese forces advanced toward Dangshan and took it on 24 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月30日至31日，日军由蒙城西犯，涡阳、亳县相继失陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 30–31 May 1938 Japanese forces advanced west from Mengcheng, taking Guoyang and Boxian in succession. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月14日合肥失陷后，日军沿合安公路南下，6月12日攻占安庆。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Hefei fell on 14 May 1938, Japanese forces advanced south along the Hefei–Anqing road and took Anqing on 12 June. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年6月19日潜山失陷后，日军沿大别山南麓西进，6月30日陷太湖，8月2日陷宿松。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Qianshan fell on 19 June 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the southern foot of the Dabie Mountains, taking Taihu on 30 June and Susong on 2 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月14日合肥失陷后，日军第2军沿大别山北麓西进，8月28日陷六安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Hefei fell on 14 May 1938, the Japanese 2nd Army advanced west along the northern foot of the Dabie Mountains and took Lu'an on 28 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年8月28日六安失陷后，日军第13师团南下，8月29日陷霍山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Lu'an fell on 28 August 1938, the Japanese 13th Division moved south and took Huoshan on 29 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月28日东流、贵池失陷，11月26日铜陵失陷；日军沿长江南岸西进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Dongliu and Guichi fell on 28 October 1938 and Tongling on 26 November; Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月5日德州失守后，日军第10师团沿津浦路南犯，12月27日占领济南。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Dezhou fell on 5 October 1937, the Japanese 10th Division advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and occupied Jinan on 27 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月27日济南失守后，日军沿津浦路南下，12月31日占领泰安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jinan fell on 27 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and occupied Tai'an on 31 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月31日泰安失守后，日军沿津浦路南下，1938年1月4日占兖州、曲阜，1月5日占邹县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Tai'an fell on 31 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway, taking Yanzhou and Qufu on 4 January 1938 and Zouxian on 5 January. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月5日邹县失守后，日军西犯，1月11日占济宁，1月16日占汶上。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zouxian fell on 5 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced west, taking Jining on 11 January and Wenshang on 16 January. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月26日周村失守后，日军沿胶济铁路南侧推进，12月27日占领淄川。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zhoucun fell on 26 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced along the southern side of the Jiaoji railway and occupied Zichuan on 27 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月10日青岛失守后，日军沿青烟公路北犯，1月17日侵占即墨城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Qingdao fell on 10 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced north along the Qingdao–Yantai road and occupied Jimo on 17 January. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月10日青岛失守后，日军沿青烟公路北犯，2月3日占领烟台。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Qingdao fell on 10 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced north along the Qingdao–Yantai road and occupied Yantai on 3 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月3日烟台失守后，日军分兵东进，3月7日占领威海卫。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yantai fell on 3 February 1938, Japanese forces moved east and occupied Weihaiwei on 7 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月5日邹县失守后，日军沿津浦路南下，3月17日占滕县、临城，3月18日占峄县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zouxian fell on 5 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway, taking Tengxian and Lincheng on 17 March and Yixian on 18 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月18日，日军占领峄县后北进枣庄，抢占中兴煤矿。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 18 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yixian and moved north into Zaozhuang, seizing the Zhongxing coal mines. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月10日潍县失守后，日军第5师团沿胶济路—莒县方向南犯，4月21日占领临沂。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Weixian fell on 10 January 1938, the Japanese 5th Division advanced south via the Jiaoji railway and Ju county, occupying Linyi on 21 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月9日郓城失守后，日军第16师团西犯，5月14日占领菏泽。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yuncheng fell on 9 May 1938, the Japanese 16th Division advanced west and occupied Heze on 14 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月14日至15日，日军分3路进犯鲁西北，攻破聊城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 14–15 November 1938 Japanese forces advanced into northwestern Shandong in three columns and broke into Liaocheng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军由德州方向侵入临清、高唐。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces advanced from the Dezhou direction into Linqing and Gaotang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军由临清方向侵入高唐。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces advanced from the Linqing direction into Gaotang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月11日，日军由曲阜方向占领泗水。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 11 January 1938 Japanese forces advanced from the Qufu direction and occupied Sishui. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月5日，日军由烟台西进，占领黄县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces advanced west from Yantai and occupied Huangxian. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月11日济宁失守后，日军向西南推进，5月14日攻破金乡城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jining fell on 11 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced southwest and broke into Jinxiang on 14 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月5日日军在金山卫登陆后西进，11月19日攻陷嘉兴。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After landing at Jinshanwei on 5 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west and captured Jiaxing on 19 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日嘉兴失守后，日军沿太湖南岸西进，11月24日陷湖州，11月25日陷长兴。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jiaxing fell on 19 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the southern shore of Taihu, taking Huzhou on 24 November and Changxing on 25 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月24日湖州失守后，日军南下，12月24日分3路侵入杭州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Huzhou fell on 24 November 1937, Japanese forces moved south and entered Hangzhou in three columns on 24 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日嘉兴失守后，日军沿沪杭铁路西进，12月24日攻陷杭州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jiaxing fell on 19 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Shanghai–Hangzhou railway and captured Hangzhou on 24 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年1月22日，日军由杭州方向偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 22 January 1940 Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River from the Hangzhou direction and captured Xiaoshan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年4月17日，日军由萧山方向分3路进犯绍兴，凌晨占领绍兴城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 17 April 1941 Japanese forces advanced on Shaoxing from the Xiaoshan direction in three columns and occupied the city before dawn. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年4月17日绍兴失守后，日军经余姚、慈溪东犯，4月20日攻陷宁波；4月22日慈溪、4月23日余姚相继沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Shaoxing fell on 17 April 1941, Japanese forces advanced east via Yuyao and Cixi and captured Ningbo on 20 April; Cixi fell on 22 April and Yuyao on 23 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年4月23日，日军由宁波南下，攻陷奉化。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 23 April 1941 Japanese forces moved south from Ningbo and captured Fenghua. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月17日诸暨失守后，日军经东阳、义乌西犯，5月28日陷金华。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zhuji fell on 17 May 1942, Japanese forces advanced west via Dongyang and Yiwu and took Jinhua on 28 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月28日，金华、兰溪同日失陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Jinhua and Lanxi fell on the same day, 28 May 1942. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月28日金华失守后，日军西犯衢州，6月8日城破。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jinhua fell on 28 May 1942, Japanese forces advanced west on Quzhou and broke into the city on 8 June. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月28日金华失守后，日军南下，6月24日侵占丽水县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jinhua fell on 28 May 1942, Japanese forces moved south and occupied Lishui on 24 June. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年6月24日丽水失守后，日军东进，7月11日温州第二次沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Lishui fell on 24 June 1942, Japanese forces moved east and Wenzhou fell for the second time on 11 July. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年7月14日，嵊县、新昌同日沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Shengxian and Xinchang fell on the same day, 14 July 1942. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月26日，日军在料罗湾登陆后向金门县城推进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 26 October 1937 Japanese forces landed at Liaoluo Bay and advanced on the Kinmen county town. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年4月19日日军登陆闽江口，经长乐向福州推进，4月21日福州沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary on 19 April 1941 and advanced via Changle on Fuzhou, which fell on 21 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年4月19日日军登陆闽江口，经连江向福州推进，4月21日福州沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary on 19 April 1941 and advanced via Lianjiang on Fuzhou, which fell on 21 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年7月16日，日军在永宁、崇武一带登陆，制造永宁、崇武惨案。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed around Yongning and Chongwu and carried out the Yongning and Chongwu massacres. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年7月11日，日伪军在东山港登陆，进攻东山城，7月16日败退。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 11 July 1939 Japanese and puppet forces landed at Dongshan port and attacked Dongshan town; they were driven off on 16 July. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年6月29日彭泽失守后，日军沿长江南岸西进，7月4日攻占湖口。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Pengze fell on 29 June 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze and captured Hukou on 4 July. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年7月4日湖口失守后，日军沿江西进，7月26日攻占九江。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Hukou fell on 4 July 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the river and captured Jiujiang on 26 July. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年7月26日九江失守后，日军西进，8月24日攻占瑞昌。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jiujiang fell on 26 July 1938, Japanese forces advanced west and captured Ruichang on 24 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年7月26日九江失守后，日军沿鄱阳湖西岸南下，8月20日攻占星子。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Jiujiang fell on 26 July 1938, Japanese forces advanced south along the western shore of Poyang Lake and captured Xingzi on 20 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年8月20日星子失守后，日军向德安推进，10月27日攻占德安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xingzi fell on 20 August 1938, Japanese forces advanced on De'an and captured it on 27 October. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年3月22日永修失守后，日军沿南浔铁路南下，3月27日攻占南昌。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yongxiu fell on 22 March 1939, Japanese forces advanced south along the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway and captured Nanchang on 27 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年3月27日南昌失守后，日军一部西进，3月29日攻占高安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Nanchang fell on 27 March 1939, a Japanese column advanced west and captured Gao'an on 29 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年3月27日南昌失守后，日军一部西进，4月2日攻占奉新。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Nanchang fell on 27 March 1939, a Japanese column advanced west and captured Fengxin on 2 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年2月5日赣州失守后，日军西南进犯，2月6日攻占南康。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Ganzhou fell on 5 February 1945, Japanese forces advanced southwest and captured Nankang on 6 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年7月27日日军攻占廊坊，7月29日至30日北平、天津相继沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces captured Langfang on 27 July 1937, and Beiping and Tianjin fell on 29–30 July. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年7月29日，日军占领北平东面门户通州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 29 July 1937 Japanese forces occupied Tongzhou, the eastern gateway to Beiping. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年7月30日天津失守后，日军沿津浦线南犯，9月24日攻占沧州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Tianjin fell on 30 July 1937, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and captured Cangzhou on 24 September. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月24日保定失守后，日军沿平汉线南犯，10月8日陷定县，10月10日陷石家庄。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Baoding fell on 24 September 1937, Japanese forces advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway, taking Dingxian on 8 October and Shijiazhuang on 10 October. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月10日石家庄失守后，日军沿平汉线南犯，10月15日陷邢台，10月17日陷邯郸，10月18日陷磁县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Shijiazhuang fell on 10 October 1937, Japanese forces advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway, taking Xingtai on 15 October, Handan on 17 October and Cixian on 18 October. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月17日邯郸失守后，日军向东南进犯，11月12日攻占大名。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Handan fell on 17 October 1937, Japanese forces advanced southeast and captured Daming on 12 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月9日阳高失守、12日天镇失守后，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团由东向西推进，9月13日占领大同。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yanggao fell on 9 September and Tianzhen on the 12th, the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force advanced westward and occupied Datong on 13 September 1937. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 大同失守后，日军独立混成第15旅团于9月14日占领怀仁，混成第1旅团于9月19日占领左云。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Datong fell, the Japanese Independent Mixed 15th Brigade occupied Huairen on 14 September and the 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun on the 19th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军混成第1旅团由大同南下，9月28日攻占朔县并制造朔县屠城，10月2日占领宁武。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade moved south from Datong, took Shuoxian on 28 September and carried out the Shuoxian massacre, then occupied Ningwu on 2 October. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军第5师团第21旅团9月14日攻占广灵后西进，9月20日占领灵丘，随后进攻平型关。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After capturing Guangling on 14 September, the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade moved west and occupied Lingqiu on the 20th before attacking Pingxingguan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军混成第15旅团、第2旅团越过内长城后，9月29日陷繁峙、30日陷代县、10月8日陷崞县、10日占原平，进逼忻口。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After crossing the Inner Great Wall, Japanese mixed brigades took Fanshi on 29 September, Daixian on the 30th, Guoxian on 8 October and Yuanping on the 10th, closing on Xinkou. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 娘子关—平定—阳泉—寿阳—榆次—太原

description.zh: 日军第20师团10月26日攻陷娘子关后沿正太线西追，29日侵占平定，30日占阳泉，11月2日占寿阳，5日进占榆次，进逼太原。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Niangziguan on 26 October, the Japanese 20th Division pursued west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, occupying Pingding on the 29th, Yangquan on the 30th, Shouyang on 2 November and Yuci on the 5th, closing on Taiyuan. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 太原—榆次—太谷—祁县—平遥

description.zh: 太原失守后，日军第20师团沿同蒲线南下，11月9日侵占平遥。路线为示意简化；太谷、祁县为该线经过的县城。
description.en: After Taiyuan fell, the Japanese 20th Division moved south along the Tongpu railway and occupied Pingyao on 9 November. The route is schematic; Taigu and Qixian lie along it.

name.zh: 邯郸—东阳关—黎城—潞城—长治

description.zh: 1938年2月，日军第108师团由平汉线西犯，突破东阳关川军防线，经黎城、潞城，2月20日攻占长治。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In February 1938 the Japanese 108th Division advanced west from the Beiping–Hankou railway, broke the Sichuan defense at Dongyangguan and, via Licheng and Lucheng, captured Changzhi on 20 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军第108师团等部由长治南下，2月26日第一次占领晋城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese 108th Division and other units moved south from Changzhi and occupied Jincheng for the first time on 26 February. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 太原—介休—霍县—洪洞—临汾

description.zh: 1938年2月，日军第1军沿同蒲线南犯晋南，2月28日占领临汾。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In February 1938 the Japanese First Army advanced south along the Tongpu railway into southern Shanxi and occupied Linfen on 28 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 临汾失守后，日军继续南犯，3月5日侵占运城，随后进抵黄河风陵渡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Linfen fell the Japanese advanced further south, occupying Yuncheng on 5 March and reaching the Fenglingdu crossing on the Yellow River. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年5月中条山会战，日军以中央突破攻陷垣曲后向西推进，进抵平陆、黄河北岸。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In the May 1941 Zhongtiao Mountains campaign the Japanese broke through the center, took Yuanqu and pushed west toward Pinglu on the north bank of the Yellow River. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月3日日军第14师团自磁县强渡漳河，4日攻占安阳车站，5日攻陷安阳城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 3 November 1937 the Japanese 14th Division crossed the Zhang River from Cixian, took Anyang station on the 4th and the city on the 5th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 安阳—汤阴—淇县—汲县—新乡

description.zh: 1938年2月10日日军第14师团主力自安阳沿平汉路南犯，经汤阴、淇县、汲县，17日陷新乡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 10 February 1938 the main force of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Anyang along the Beiping–Hankou railway through Tangyin, Qi County and Jixian to Xinxiang on the 17th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 大名—南乐—清丰—濮阳—长垣—封丘—新乡

description.zh: 1938年2月7日日军第14师团馆支队自大名南犯，连陷南乐、清丰、濮阳、长垣、封丘，17日与主力会合于新乡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 7 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Daming through Nanle, Qingfeng, Puyang, Changyuan and Fengqiu, joining the main force at Xinxiang on the 17th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 新乡—获嘉—修武—焦作—博爱—沁阳—孟县—济源

description.zh: 1938年2月17日日军自新乡沿道清铁路西犯，经获嘉、修武、焦作、博爱、沁阳、孟县，25日陷济源。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 17 February 1938 the Japanese advanced west from Xinxiang along the Daoqing railway through Huojia, Xiuwu, Jiaozuo, Bo’ai, Qinyang and Mengxian to Jiyuan on the 25th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月12日日军华中派遣军第13师团自蒙城北上占领永城，随后攻夏邑、切断陇海路。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 12 May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division advanced north from Mengcheng and took Yongcheng, then Xiayi, cutting the Longhai railway. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月29日日军第16师团自砀山经虞城进占商丘。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 29 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division advanced from Dangshan via Yucheng and occupied Shangqiu. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 商丘—杞县—通许—尉氏—中牟

description.zh: 1938年6月初日军第16师团自商丘西犯，连陷杞县、通许、尉氏，9日第14师团攻占中牟，直逼郑州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In early June 1938 the Japanese 16th Division advanced west from Shangqiu through Qi County, Tongxu and Weishi, while the 14th Division took Zhongmou on the 9th and closed on Zhengzhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年9月6日日军第10师团濑谷支队自六安、叶家集北犯占领固始。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 6 September 1938 the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division advanced north from Lu’an and Yejiaji to take Gushi. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 固始—潢川—光山—罗山—信阳

description.zh: 1938年9月至10月日军第10师团自固始西犯，经潢川、光山、罗山，10月12日攻占信阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From September to October 1938 the Japanese 10th Division advanced west from Gushi through Huangchuan, Guangshan and Luoshan to Xinyang on 12 October. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年1月26日至27日日军第11军自信阳北犯，攻占确山、驻马店、泌阳一线。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 26–27 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army advanced north from Xinyang, taking the Queshan–Zhumadian–Biyang line. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年4月18日日军第37师团在中牟强渡新黄河，23日占领郑州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division crossed the New Yellow River at Zhongmou and occupied Zhengzhou on the 23rd. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年4月23日日军占领郑州后沿平汉铁路南犯，经新郑、长葛，5月1日陷许昌。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Zhengzhou on 23 April 1944 the Japanese advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway through Xinzheng and Changge to Xuchang on 1 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月1日许昌失守后，日军一部沿平汉铁路南下，经临颍、漯河，5月8日与北上的第11军会合于西平。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xuchang fell on 1 May 1944 part of the Japanese force drove south along the Beiping–Hankou railway through Linying and Luohe, joining the northward-moving 11th Army at Xiping on 8 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月1日至4日日军第62师团、战车第3师团自许昌向西迂回，连陷禹县、郏县、临汝。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 1 to 4 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division and 3rd Tank Division swept west from Xuchang through Yu County and Jiaxian to Linru. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月4日临汝失守后，日军经登封东进，9日“菊兵团”攻占巩县，迫近洛阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Linru fell on 4 May 1944 the Japanese advanced via Dengfeng; on the 9th the Kiku detachment took Gong County and closed on Luoyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月4日临汝失守后，日军一部南下，连陷宝丰、鲁山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Linru fell on 4 May 1944 part of the Japanese force drove south through Baofeng to Lushan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月9日日军第69师团自垣曲强渡黄河，12日攻陷渑池、新安，直逼洛阳城西。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 9 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division crossed the Yellow River from Yuanqu, took Mianchi and Xin’an on the 12th and closed on Luoyang from the west. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年3月30日日军第110师团、战车第3师团自南阳西犯，陷西峡口，4月1日陷淅川。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division advanced west from Nanyang, took Xixiakou and on 1 April Xichuan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年8月13日日军大泉支队抵沽源，堤支队已先抵张北；混成第2旅团自张北出击，24日占万全，27日占张家口。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 13 August 1937 the Oizumi detachment reached Guyuan while the Tsutsumi detachment was already at Zhangbei; the 2nd Mixed Brigade sortied from Zhangbei, took Wanquan on the 24th and Zhangjiakou on the 27th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年8月20日大泉支队自沽源南进，经独石口、赤城、龙关，28日占宣化。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 20 August 1937 the Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan through Dushikou, Chicheng and Longguan, taking Xuanhua on the 28th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年8月27日张家口失陷后，日军第5师团与独立混成第11旅团东进，占怀来、延庆，28日与自赤城南下的部队会合于宣化。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zhangjiakou fell on 27 August 1937 the Japanese 5th Division and 11th Independent Mixed Brigade advanced east through Xuanhua, Huailai and Yanqing, joining the force from Chicheng at Xuanhua on the 28th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月11日日军自集宁出发，经凉城（宁远）南下，14日逼近归绥。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 11 October 1937 the Japanese advanced south from Jining through Liangcheng (Ningyuan) and closed on Guisui on the 14th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月11日伪蒙军自集宁沿大青山北麓经武川包抄归绥。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 11 October 1937 the Mongol puppet forces advanced from Jining along the northern foot of the Daqing Mountains through Wuchuan to outflank Guisui. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月6日日军第5师团自宣化南下，11日骑兵第5联队占蔚县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 6 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division advanced south from Xuanhua; on the 11th its 5th Cavalry Regiment took Yu County. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月19日河村支队占兴和，24日与松井支队会合攻克隆城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1937 the Kawamura detachment took Xinghe; on the 24th it joined the Matsui detachment to capture Liangcheng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年7月26日日军自小池口登陆，8月2日占黄梅，9月6日占广济，16日占武穴。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 26 July 1938 the Japanese landed at Xiaochikou, took Huangmei on 2 August, Guangji on 6 September and Wuxue on the 16th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年9月16日日军占武穴后，沿长江北岸进攻田家镇要塞，29日攻陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Wuxue on 16 September 1938 the Japanese advanced along the north bank against the Tianjiazhen fortress, which fell on the 29th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年9月24日日军占富池口，10月4日强渡攻占南岸半壁山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Fuchikou on 24 September 1938 and crossed the river to take Banbishan on the south bank on 4 October. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 田家镇—蕲春—浠水—黄冈—团风—黄陂

description.zh: 1938年9月底至10月，日军第6师团自田家镇沿江西进，经蕲春、浠水、黄冈、团风，24日占黄陂。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From late September to October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division advanced west from Tianjiazhen through Qichun, Xishui, Huanggang and Tuanfeng, taking Huangpi on the 24th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 半壁山—阳新—大冶—鄂城—黄石港

description.zh: 1938年10月4日日军占半壁山后，经阳新、大冶、鄂城，20日占黄石港。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Banbishan on 4 October 1938 the Japanese advanced through Yangxin, Daye and Echeng to Huangshigang on the 20th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月24日日军占黄陂，25日夜进入汉口，26日占武昌。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Huangpi on 24 October 1938, entered Hankou on the night of the 25th and took Wuchang on the 26th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月25日日军越过大别山占麻城，27日占黄安，30日占应城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 25 October 1938 the Japanese crossed the Dabie Mountains to Macheng, took Huang’an on the 27th and Yingcheng on the 30th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月20日日军占黄石港后，沿粤汉线南下，29日占咸宁，11月6日占崇阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Huangshigang on 20 October 1938 the Japanese moved south along the Canton–Hankou railway, taking Xianning on the 29th and Chongyang on 6 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年5月1日日军第11军向随枣进攻，8日占随县、枣阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 1 May 1939 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Suixian and Zaoyang, taking both on the 8th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年6月1日日军占襄阳，3日第3师团占南漳、第39师团占宜城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Xiangyang on 1 June 1940; on the 3rd the 3rd Division took Nanzhang and the 39th Division Yicheng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年6月3日日军占宜城后南下，6日占荆门，8日占江陵（荆州），9日占当阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Yicheng on 3 June 1940 the Japanese moved south, taking Jingmen on the 6th, Jiangling (Jingzhou) on the 8th and Dangyang on the 9th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 荆州—公安—松滋—宜都—长阳

description.zh: 1943年5月14日日军占公安，18日占松滋，22日占宜都，24日占长阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In May 1943 the Japanese took Gong’an on the 14th, Songzi on the 18th, Yidu on the 22nd and Changyang on the 24th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年3月21日日军第39师团自荆门北犯，23日占宜城，29日占襄阳，30日占樊城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 21 March 1945 the Japanese 39th Division advanced north from Jingmen, taking Yicheng on the 23rd, Xiangyang on the 29th and Fancheng on the 30th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年3月30日日军占樊城后西犯，4月7日占谷城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Fancheng on 30 March 1945 the Japanese moved west and took Gucheng on 7 April. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年9月18日日军进攻新墙河，23日强渡，26日渡汨罗江。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 18 September 1939 the Japanese attacked the Xinqiang River, crossed it on the 23rd and crossed the Miluo on the 26th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年9月23日日军在营田登陆，30日一部进抵长沙以北永安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese landed at Yingtian on 23 September 1939; on the 30th a detachment reached Yong’an north of Changsha. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年9月29日日军第33师团攻占平江，一部向永安方向策应。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division took Pingjiang, with part of its force moving toward Yong’an. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 大云山—新墙河—汨罗江—长沙

description.zh: 1941年9月7日日军进攻大云山，18日渡新墙河，21日渡汨罗江，28日突入长沙。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 7 September 1941 the Japanese attacked Dayun Mountain, crossed the Xinqiang on the 18th and the Miluo on the 21st, and entered Changsha on the 28th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年9月28日日军突入长沙，29日第3师团一部攻入株洲。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese entered Changsha on 28 September 1941; on the 29th part of the 3rd Division entered Zhuzhou. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 新墙河—汨罗江—长沙（1941年12月）

description.zh: 1941年12月24日日军进攻新墙河，26日渡汨罗江，1942年1月1日进攻长沙。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 24 December 1941 the Japanese attacked the Xinqiang River, crossed the Miluo on the 26th and attacked Changsha on 1 January 1942. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1943年11月3日日军占南县，7日占安乡，12月3日占常德。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Nanxian on 3 November 1943, Anxiang on the 7th and Changde on 3 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1943年11月15日日军占石门，17日占澧县，12月3日占常德。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Shimen on 15 November 1943, Lixian on the 17th and Changde on 3 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1943年11月22日日军占慈利、桃源，12月3日占常德。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Cili and Taoyuan on 22 November 1943 and Changde on 3 December. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 新墙河—汨罗江—湘阴—长沙（1944）

description.zh: 1944年5月28日日军渡新墙河，6月8日占湘阴，18日攻长沙，19日陷城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese crossed the Xinqiang on 28 May 1944, took Xiangyin on 8 June and attacked Changsha on the 18th; the city fell on the 19th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月1日日军占平江，14日占浏阳，20日占株洲。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Pingjiang on 1 June 1944, Liuyang on the 14th and Zhuzhou on the 20th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月19日日军陷长沙，20日占湘潭，8月8日陷衡阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Changsha fell on 19 June 1944, Xiangtan on the 20th and Hengyang on 8 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月20日日军占株洲，24日东路占攸县、耒阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Zhuzhou on 20 June 1944; on the 24th the eastern column took Youxian and Leiyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年4月16日日军占新宁，27日围攻武冈，29日进抵洞口。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Xinning on 16 April 1945, besieged Wugang on the 27th and reached Dongkou on the 29th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1945年4月21日日军占洞口，29日攻占武阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Dongkou on 21 April 1945 and Wuyang on the 29th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月5日日军占沅江，12日占益阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Yuanjiang on 5 June 1944 and Yiyang on the 12th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 钦州湾—防城—钦县—小董—南宁

description.zh: 1939年11月15日日军在钦州湾登陆，连陷防城、钦县、小董，24日攻占南宁。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 15 November 1939 the Japanese landed at Qinzhou Bay, took Fangcheng, Qin County and Xiaodong, and captured Nanning on the 24th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年11月24日日军占南宁，12月1日占高峰隘，4日占昆仑关。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Nanning on 24 November 1939, Gaofeng Pass on 1 December and Kunlun Pass on the 4th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年12月21日日军由南宁西进攻陷龙州，截断桂越交通线。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 21 December 1939 the Japanese advanced west from Nanning and took Longzhou, cutting the Guangxi–Vietnam route. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年2月日军反扑，3日占宾阳，8日占武鸣。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In February 1940 the Japanese counterattacked, taking Binyang on the 3rd and Wuming on the 8th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 黄沙河—全州—兴安—灵川—桂林

description.zh: 1944年9月11日日军陷黄沙河，14日占全州，30日占兴安，10月27日占灵川，11月10日陷桂林。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In 1944 the Japanese took Huangshahe on 11 September, Quanzhou on the 14th, Xing’an on the 30th, Lingchuan on 27 October and Guilin on 10 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年9月22日日军陷梧州，10月11日占平南、桂平。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Wuzhou on 22 September 1944, Pingnan and Guiping on 11 October. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 桂林—柳州—宜山—河池—南丹

description.zh: 1944年11月10日日军陷桂林、柳州，15日占宜山，22日占河池，28日占南丹。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Guilin and Liuzhou fell on 10 November 1944, Yishan on the 15th, Hechi on the 22nd and Nandan on the 28th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月11日日军由柳州西进，17日占忻城，15日占宜山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 11 November 1944 the Japanese advanced west from Liuzhou, taking Xincheng on the 17th and Yishan on the 15th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月21日日军占宾阳，23日占武鸣，24日占南宁。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Binyang on 21 November 1944, Wuming on the 23rd and Nanning on the 24th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月24日日军占南宁，28日占凭祥，12月2日占龙州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Nanning on 24 November 1944, Pingxiang on the 28th and Longzhou on 2 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1940年2月8日日军由宾阳分兵进占上林。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 8 February 1940 the Japanese detached a force from Binyang to occupy Shanglin. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 畹町—遮放—芒市—龙陵—惠通桥

description.zh: 1942年5月3日日军侵入畹町，连陷遮放、芒市、龙陵，5日进抵惠通桥西岸。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 3 May 1942 the Japanese entered Wanding, took Zhefang, Mangshi and Longling in succession, and reached the west bank of the Huitong Bridge on the 5th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月10日日军由龙陵方向侵入腾冲。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 10 May 1942 the Japanese advanced from Longling into Tengchong. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月3日日军占领瑞丽（勐卯）。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 3 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Ruili (Mengmao). The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1942年5月4日至10日日军分兵占领陇川、盈江、梁河。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 4 to 10 May 1942 the Japanese detached forces to occupy Longchuan, Yingjiang and Lianghe. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月至9月日军松山守备队扼守松山—惠通桥一线，9月7日被中国远征军攻克。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From June to September 1944 the Japanese Songshan garrison held the Songshan–Huitong Bridge line until the Chinese Expeditionary Force took it on 7 September. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月至11月日军松山、龙陵守备队互为犄角，11月3日龙陵被中国远征军收复。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From June to November 1944 the Japanese garrisons at Songshan and Longling supported each other until Longling was recovered on 3 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月至11月日军腾冲、龙陵守备队互为犄角，9月14日腾冲、11月3日龙陵被中国远征军收复。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From June to November 1944 the Japanese garrisons at Tengchong and Longling supported each other until Tengchong fell on 14 September and Longling on 3 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月至11月日军在平戛构筑据点，掩护龙陵侧翼。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From June to November 1944 the Japanese fortified Pingjia to cover Longling’s flank. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月至11月日军在象达构筑据点，掩护龙陵侧翼。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From June to November 1944 the Japanese fortified Xiangda to cover Longling’s flank. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月28日日军占南丹，30日进入贵州麻尾，12月2日攻占独山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Nandan on 28 November 1944, entered Mawei in Guizhou on the 30th and captured Dushan on 2 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月25日日军进攻黎明关，27日突破，12月3日攻入荔波县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 25 November 1944 the Japanese attacked Liming Pass, broke through on the 27th and entered Libo on 3 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月30日日军占三都，12月2日占丹寨，3日进抵都匀以东牛场。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Sandu on 30 November 1944, Danzhai on 2 December and reached Niuchang east of Duyun on the 3rd. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 独山—都匀（日军撤退方向）

description.zh: 1944年12月4日日军由独山反转，沿黔桂公路向都匀方向撤退，8日全部退出独山县境。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 4 December 1944 the Japanese turned back from Dushan and withdrew along the Guizhou–Guangxi highway toward Duyun, leaving Dushan county by the 8th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 沈阳—营口—海城—盖平—复县

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军沿南满铁路南段侵占营口、海城、盖平、复县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Yingkou, Haicheng, Gaiping and Fuxian along the southern section of the South Manchuria Railway. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军第2师团自辽阳、鞍山方向进攻沈阳，同日控制辽阳、鞍山、海城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division moved from Liaoyang and Anshan against Shenyang, while Liaoyang, Anshan and Haicheng were brought under control the same day. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军沿南满铁路北段侵占铁岭、开原。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Tieling and Kaiyuan along the northern section of the South Manchuria Railway. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军沿安奉铁路侵占本溪、凤城、安东。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi, Fengcheng and Andong along the Anfeng railway. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军侵占抚顺。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Fushun. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年11月23日日军侵占辽西重镇新民。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 23 November 1931 the Japanese occupied Xinmin, the key town of western Liaoning. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年1月4日日军自锦州沿北宁铁路西进，侵占兴城、绥中、葫芦岛。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 4 January 1932 the Japanese advanced west from Jinzhou along the Beining railway and occupied Xingcheng, Suizhong and Huludao. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年1月7日日军占义县，13日占北镇。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Yi County on 7 January 1932 and Beizhen on the 13th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年1月11日日军依田旅团攻占锦西县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 11 January 1932 the Japanese Ida brigade captured Jinxi. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年12月16日日军自海城方向进攻岫岩，侵占县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 December 1932 the Japanese advanced from the Haicheng direction and occupied Xiuyan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月19日日军沿南满铁路同时侵占四平街、长春。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Sipingjie and Changchun along the South Manchuria Railway. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年4月3日，日本驻朝鲜第19师团“间岛派遣队”侵入延吉、龙井。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 3 April 1932 the “Jiandao Expeditionary Force” of the Japanese 19th Division entered Yanji and Longjing. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年1月31日日军攻占双城堡，2月5日进占哈尔滨。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Shuangcheng on 31 January 1932 and entered Harbin on 5 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年2月17日日军占海林，5月21日占牡丹江。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Hailin on 17 February 1932 and Mudanjiang on 21 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年5月16日至17日，日军第10师团自哈尔滨方向攻陷依兰。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16–17 May 1932 the Japanese 10th Division advanced from the Harbin direction and captured Yilan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年5月17日日军自依兰顺松花江方向侵占佳木斯。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 17 May 1932 the Japanese advanced from Yilan down the Songhua and occupied Jiamusi. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1932年5月30日至6月1日，日军平贺旅团沿呼海铁路北犯，6月1日侵占海伦。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 30 May to 1 June 1932 the Japanese Hiraga brigade advanced north along the Huhai railway and occupied Hailun on 1 June. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年1月1日日军自牡丹江东进，在磨刀石遭李延禄部阻击；5日竹本支队侵占绥芬河。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 1 January 1933 the Japanese advanced east from Mudanjiang and were checked by Li Yanlu at Modaoshi; on the 5th the Takeuchi detachment occupied Suifenhe. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年1月10日日军自穆棱方向侵占东宁县城三岔口。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 10 January 1933 the Japanese advanced from the Muling direction and occupied Sanchakou, the seat of Dongning County. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 牡丹江—林口—梨树镇—密山

description.zh: 1933年1月1日至6日，日军自牡丹江经林口、梨树镇侵占密山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 1 to 6 January 1933 the Japanese advanced from Mudanjiang through Linkou and Lishuzhen to Mishan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年1月8日至9日，日军饭冢支队自佳木斯经集贤、三道岗侵占宝清。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 8 to 9 January 1933 the Japanese Iizuka detachment advanced from Jiamusi through Jixian and Sandaogang to Baoqing. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1931年9月22日日军侵占四洮铁路沿线，25日进入洮南。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 22 September 1931 the Japanese occupied the Sitao railway line and entered Tao’nan on the 25th. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 齐齐哈尔—扎兰屯—牙克石—博克图—海拉尔—满洲里

description.zh: 1932年11月30日至12月6日，日军第14师团沿中东铁路西段攻占扎兰屯、牙克石、博克图、海拉尔、满洲里。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 30 November to 6 December 1932 the Japanese 14th Division advanced along the western Chinese Eastern Railway and took Zhalantun, Yakeshi, Bukettu, Hailar and Manzhouli. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年2月23日至25日，日军第8师团自锦州沿锦朝线攻占北票、朝阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 23 to 25 February 1933 the Japanese 8th Division advanced from Jinzhou along the Jinchao railway and took Beipiao and Chaoyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年2月23日至3月2日，日军第6师团自开鲁经下洼、老哈河方向进攻赤峰。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 23 February to 2 March 1933 the Japanese 6th Division advanced from Kailu through Xiawa and the Laoha River toward Chifeng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年2月28日至3月2日，日军混成第14旅团自凌南向凌源推进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 28 February to 2 March 1933 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade advanced from Lingnan toward Lingyuan. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 朝阳—叶柏寿—凌源—平泉—承德

description.zh: 1933年3月1日至4日，日军第8师团沿朝阳、凌源、平泉公路推进，4日侵占承德。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 1 to 4 March 1933 the Japanese 8th Division advanced along the Chaoyang–Lingyuan–Pingquan road and occupied Chengde on the 4th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年3月2日至8日，日军自赤峰向围场推进，8日侵占围场。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 2 to 8 March 1933 the Japanese advanced from Chifeng toward Weichang and occupied it on the 8th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1933年3月2日至6日，日军自赤峰方向进攻林西，6日侵占林西。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 2 to 6 March 1933 the Japanese advanced from the Chifeng direction and occupied Linxi on the 6th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月14日至18日，日军第20师团沿平汉线自北平经良乡进攻涿州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 14 to 18 September 1937 the Japanese 20th Division advanced along the Pinghan railway from Beiping through Liangxiang to Zhuozhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月15日日军第14师团在永清、固安渡过永定河，随后向涿州方向推进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 15 September 1937 the Japanese 14th Division crossed the Yongding River at Yongqing and Gu’an and advanced toward Zhuozhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月8日日军攻占正定，10日进攻石家庄。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese took Zhengding on 8 October 1937 and attacked Shijiazhuang on the 10th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月10日日军攻占石家庄后，11日侵占井陉煤矿。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After taking Shijiazhuang on 10 October 1937, the Japanese seized the Jingxing coal mines on the 11th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月16日，日军由大同经瓮城口峪进入浑源。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 September 1937 the Japanese advanced from Datong through Wengcheng Pass into Hunyuan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月20日，日军一部由大同开到应县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 20 September 1937 a Japanese force moved from Datong to Yingxian. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月18日至20日，日军自大同方向攻占山阴、右玉。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 18 to 20 September 1937 the Japanese advanced from the Datong direction and took Shanyin and Youyu. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年10月30日至11月2日，日军第109师团一部自井陉经九龙关攻占昔阳。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 30 October to 2 November 1937 a unit of the Japanese 109th Division advanced from Jingxing through Jiulong Pass and took Xiyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月4日至9日，日军第20师团自榆次南下，连陷太谷、祁县，9日占平遥。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 4 to 9 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division advanced south from Yuci, taking Taigu and Qixian in succession and occupying Pingyao on the 9th. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月8日至13日，日军自太原西进，占领清源、交城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 8 to 13 November 1937 the Japanese advanced west from Taiyuan and occupied Qingyuan and Jiaocheng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月16日至17日，日军自新乡进攻辉县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 16 to 17 February 1938 the Japanese advanced from Xinxiang to Huixian. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月16日，日军自新乡方向侵占延津。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 February 1938 the Japanese advanced from the Xinxiang direction and occupied Yanjin. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月16日，日军自延津西进，侵占阳武、原武。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 February 1938 the Japanese advanced west from Yanjin and occupied Yangwu and Yuanwu. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月16日，日军同日侵占良乡、房山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Liangxiang and Fangshan on the same day. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年9月16日至17日，日军自良乡方向进攻琉璃河。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 16 to 17 September 1937 the Japanese advanced from the Liangxiang direction to Liulihe. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月22日至3月5日，日军自孟县方向进攻温县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 22 February to 5 March 1938 the Japanese advanced from the Mengxian direction to Wenxian. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月26日与1938年1月9日，日军两次自阳泉进犯盂县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: The Japanese advanced from Yangquan against Yuxian twice, on 26 December 1937 and 9 January 1938. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月2日至3日，日军自忻口南下占领忻县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 2 to 3 November 1937 the Japanese advanced south from Xinkou and occupied Xinxian. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月4日至22日，日军自榆次方向进占徐沟。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 4 to 22 November 1937 the Japanese advanced from the Yuci direction and occupied Xugou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月29日至11月4日，日军第9师团沿粤汉线经汀泗桥、官塘驿、中伙铺南犯蒲圻。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 29 October to 4 November 1938 the Japanese 9th Division advanced south along the Canton–Hankou railway through Tiansi Bridge, Guantangyi and Zhonghuopu to Puqi. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月1日至3日，日军第9师团一部自咸宁方向进犯嘉鱼。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 1 to 3 November 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 9th Division advanced from the Xianning direction on Jiayu. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月31日至11月4日，日军铃木支队经慈口、大畈南犯通山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 31 October to 4 November 1938 the Japanese Suzuki detachment advanced south on Tongshan via Cikou and Dafan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月7日至8日，日军第27师团自崇阳追击，经大沙坪攻占通城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 7 to 8 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division pursued from Chongyang and took Tongcheng via Dashaping. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月4日至1939年1月16日，日军自应城沿汉宜公路西进，占皂市、罗店、宋河后攻陷京山县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 4 November 1938 to 16 January 1939 the Japanese advanced west from Yingcheng along the Hankou–Yichang highway, taking Zaoshi, Luodian and Songhe before capturing Jingshan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年3月3日至5日，日军自京山西南进攻钟祥。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 3 to 5 March 1939 the Japanese advanced on Zhongxiang from south-west of Jingshan. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 安乡—汉寿（常德会战东路）
name.en: Anxiang–Hanshou (eastern thrust of the Changde campaign)

description.zh: 1943年11月7日至22日，常德会战东路日军第40师团自安乡南下，沿洞庭湖西岸攻陷汉寿。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 7 to 22 November 1943 the Japanese 40th Division, on the eastern thrust of the Changde campaign, moved south from Anxiang along the western shore of Dongting Lake and took Hanshou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1943年11月17日至18日，日军自澧县南下攻陷临澧县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 17 to 18 November 1943 the Japanese moved south from Li County and took Linli. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年7月28日至29日，日军自益阳南犯宁乡，攻陷县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 28 to 29 July 1944 the Japanese advanced south from Yiyang against Ningxiang and took the county town. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月19日至21日，日军第40师团自宁乡沿湘宁大道南犯，攻陷湘乡县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 19 to 21 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division advanced south from Ningxiang along the Xiangxiang road and took Xiangxiang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月18日至21日，日军第116师团第133联队自湘潭经石潭西进，与第40师团会攻湘乡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 18 to 21 June 1944 the 133rd Regiment of the Japanese 116th Division moved west from Xiangtan via Shitan to converge on Xiangxiang with the 40th Division. The route is schematic.

name.zh: 柳城—宜山（宜山以北受阻）

description.zh: 1944年11月9日至15日，日军约3000人自柳城向西突进，被第20军拒止于宜山以北。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 9 to 15 November 1944 about 3,000 Japanese troops pushed west from Liucheng and were stopped north of Yishan by the Chinese 20th Army. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月5日至11日，日军第104师团自象县经石龙、马坪、穿山逼近柳州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 5 to 11 November 1944 the Japanese 104th Division advanced from Xiang County via Shilong, Maping and Chuanshan toward Liuzhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年11月11日至17日，日军第22师团自迁江北犯忻城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 11 to 17 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division advanced north from Qianjiang against Xincheng. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年4月19日至24日，日军第37师团自新郑经观音堂进攻密县，与第110师团合攻后攻陷县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 19 to 24 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division advanced from Xinzheng via Guanyintang against Mi County and, joined by the 110th Division, took the town. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年5月2日至5日，日军第27师团自临颍沿平汉线南下，经小商桥攻陷郾城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 2 to 5 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south from Linying along the Beiping–Hankou railway and took Yancheng via Xiaoshangqiao. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年8月8日至17日，日军第20师团自运城分三路进攻永济，攻陷蒲州城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 8 to 17 August 1938 the Japanese 20th Division attacked Yongji from Yuncheng in three columns and took the walled town of Puzhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年6月6日至8日，日军第20师团自运城经张店南下，攻陷平陆县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 6 to 8 June 1939 the Japanese 20th Division advanced south from Yuncheng via Zhangdian and took Pinglu. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月14日至18日，日军第13师团第65联队自浏阳南部大瑶南下，突破第26军阻击后攻陷醴陵。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 14 to 18 June 1944 the 65th Regiment of the Japanese 13th Division advanced south from Dayao in southern Liuyang, broke the Chinese 26th Army and took Liling. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月25日至27日，日军自攸县南下攻陷安仁县城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 25 to 27 June 1944 the Japanese advanced south from You County and took Anren. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1944年6月25日至7月14日，日军第3师团自攸县进攻茶陵，经20天城郊争夺后入城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: From 25 June to 14 July 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division advanced from You County against Chaling and entered the town after twenty days of fighting. The route is schematic.
